questions.q: What did the Honey Bee collect from the plants?
questions.explain: The bees collected nectar from the plants.

questions.q: How many Honey Bees were there?
questions.explain: A group of bees were following the main bee to collect honey.

questions.q: Why did the Honey Bees fly around?
questions.explain: The bees flew around to collect honey from different flowers.
